candidates.name: Texas Gateway Pipeline

evidence.note: 155-mile pipeline, 1.45 Bcf/d, new greenfield segment plus upgrades to Index 129; in service Nov 1 2029; precedent agreement signed.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster by name. Related Gulf South rows exist (P5932 GS Texas to Mississippi, P5926) but those are different projects. Starts in TX and ends in LA.
